payload.body: NEW - Kuwait has accused Iran of attempting a failed attack on Bubiyan Island, which hosts a China-funded port project. UAE expresses "solidarity with the State of Kuwait and its full support for all measures taken by its security authorities to counter these terrorist actions." Read here: https://www.disclose.tv/id/fjdlove4u8/ @disclosetv
